headline: Nigerian Foreign Exchange Market Turnover Drops Below $300 Million
summary: Turnover at the Nigerian Foreign Exchange Market fell to $227.18 million, dropping below the $300 million threshold for the first time since September 28.
why: Foreign exchange market turnover measures liquidity and trading activity in emerging market currencies.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Lower trading turnover reflects reduced liquidity in the foreign exchange market.
